about: Names `node tools/polestar.js i18n leaks` (tools/lib/i18n/leaks.js) lets show in English: per locale, "kind:id" of a game name no source the names build reads has in that language, with the scenes it shows in.

A new English text fails; so does an entry whose scenes all ran in its locale without it showing (fixed: remove it). `i18n leaks --update-baseline` adds the names the run found missing and drops the stale ones; it never takes English from the code or an untranslated text.

reasons.no-source: no source of `i18n names` (the client tables, the Wowhead cache, DingDB, pfQuest) names it in this language: mostly Forever's own NPCs, objects and items; the client shows its own name once the player has seen it (Names.Learn)
